# `/verified-domains` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /verified-domains/v1

`getDkimAttributesV1` — Get dkim attributes

Retrieve DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail) attributes for all your tenants' AWS SES identities. Limits retrieval to 100 identities per call.

- Scopes: sp:notification-dkim-attributes:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of dkimattributes

### POST /verified-domains/v1

`createDomainDkimV1` — Verify domain address via dkim

Create a domain to be verified via DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail)

- Scopes: sp:notification-verify-domain-dkim:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): domainaddress
- Returns 200: domainstatusdto
